in_marathi.name: Kumaresan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kumaresan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the god of prosperity, wealth and success. This name is derived from the Tamil word 'kumar' meaning youth and 'esan' meaning god.

in_bengali.name: Kumaresan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kumaresan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is the god of prosperity, wealth and success. This name is derived from the Tamil word 'kumar' meaning youth and 'esan' meaning god.
